messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Annex I, 4.1.2.8.4

4.1.2.8.4. Risk due to the load falling off the carrier Where there is a risk due to the load falling off the carrier, the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent this risk.

response.text:
machinery | mustPreventRisk | risk of the load falling off the carrier | where there is a risk due to the load falling off the carrier | "the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent this risk"
machinery | mustBeDesignedToPrevent | load falling off the carrier | where there is a risk due to the load falling off the carrier | "the machinery must be designed and constructed in such a way as to prevent this risk"
